settings.description: Register entry D3's holdout3 read (spec/V0.8-DECISIONS.md, #134): exactly the arms D3's selection rule froze from the synthesis-window-codes34 tune result, one per code, each beside its own tier's shipped arm, and the shipped code-2 floor the primary reads spurious detail against, with every setting and tune string copied from that config unchanged. Judged, each code separately and with no Holm adjustment: t3 w_min 0.85 exp 1 against t3 shipped (no window), and t4 w_min 0.7 exp 1 against t4 shipped (no window), on ΔE00 and the guards at equal bytes, and on spurious detail against t2 shipped (no window) across byte counts. Rows against the code-2 arm on any metric but spurious, which the printed tables show by default, are not judged.
